faqs.question: Why is offset-limit pagination dangerous for large SQL tables?
faqs.answer: SQL engines executing OFFSET 1000000 LIMIT 20 must scan and throw away 1,000,000 index entries before returning 20 records, leading to high CPU usage and slow responses.
